web-app.description: full team + eslint/playwright gates + all skills

data-pipeline.description: architect+coder+qa, placeholder custom gate (needs a script), all skills

role_notes.architect: Review design-system/component structure — token hierarchy, reusable component boundaries, Figma-to-code mapping — per `figma-generate-library` (variables/variants/theming foundations) and `figma-code-connect` (component-to-snippet mapping), not general system architecture.
role_notes.creative-director: Critique visual/brand direction on screens generated via `figma-generate-design` (section-by-section assembly from design-system tokens, not hardcoded values) — apply the Impact/Clarity/Disruption framework to this harness's own Figma output.
role_notes.qa: Visual regression — Playwright screenshot diffs against the design-harness's own `playwright` gate, not accessibility auditing.

server-harness.description: architect+coder+qa, no default gates, server-review skill

role_notes.architect: Audit semantic HTML/ARIA structure per `wcag-audit`'s pass 4 (screen-reader/semantics): heading order, landmarks, native elements before ARIA, programmatic name/role/value (4.1.2) — before any visual sign-off.
role_notes.creative-director: Contrast ratios and visual hierarchy for low-vision/cognitive accessibility — 1.4.3/1.4.11 contrast, 1.4.1 color-alone-signals-state, 2.4.7 focus visible, 2.4.11 focus not obscured (minimum) — per `wcag-audit` pass 3, not general brand critique.
role_notes.qa: axe-core-informed accessibility checks living in the target repo's own specs (`@axe-core/playwright`), covering the machine-detectable third per `wcag-audit` — plus the required manual keyboard-only pass; axe passing alone is not a compliance claim.
